content.title: IPL 2026 Standings: Updated Points Table After Punjab Kings vs Lucknow Super Giants​​​​​​​ Match
content.text: Punjab Kings vs Lucknow Super Giants Standings: Punjab Kings strengthened their position at the top of the Indian Premier League 2026 points table after a 54-run win over Lucknow Super Giants in Match 29 at Maharaja Yadavindra Singh International Cricket Stadium in Mullanpur Sunday, April 19, 2026. PBKS, who remain unbeaten this season, now have 11 points from six matches, including one no result, and boast a healthy net run rate of 1.420.Royal Challengers Bengaluru hold on to the second spot with eight points from six matches, followed by Rajasthan Royals in third place with the same number of points but a lower net run rate. The mid-table battle remains tight, with Sunrisers Hyderabad, Delhi Capitals and Gujarat Titans all on six points, separated only by net run rate.Lucknow Super Giants are at the eighth place after their fourth defeat of the season, with four points from six matches.
